steps.message:
The price test passes again. I haven't committed the change.

The cause was the last commit, "price: tidy up" (`ff25461`). It changed the member discount in `bin/price` from `* 90 / 100` to `* 95 / 100`, which is a 5% discount. The README, the code comment and the tests all say 10% off, so I changed it back to 90. I ran `tests/price_test.sh` and it passes.

If the business actually wants 5%, the README, comment and tests need to change instead. Someone should confirm that the "tidy up" commit didn't change the discount on purpose before you release.
